scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.read
scopes.description: Read BW modeling metadata (definitions, dependencies, transports, monitoring)

scopes.name: $XSAPPNAME.data
scopes.description: Execute BW queries and read the resulting data rows (implies read)

role-templates.name: BWModelViewer
role-templates.description: Read BW modeling metadata. Cannot read query data.

role-templates.name: BWDataViewer
role-templates.description: Execute BW queries and read data rows.

role-collections.name: BW MCP Model Viewer
role-collections.description: Read-only access to BW modeling metadata via MCP

role-collections.name: BW MCP Data Viewer
role-collections.description: Read-only access to BW modeling metadata and query data via MCP
